## Notes

- The e-mail address on task pages is the **same** `SIG_DISPUTE_EMAIL`
  build-time injection `/dispute/` renders — the publish gate's
  `data-intake-email="unset"` refusal on `dispute/index.html`
  transitively covers task pages (same env, same build); the marker is
  stamped on `task-report` for parity and testability. The operator's
  address is never committed to a file (OP-10).
- `/intake/` sits in `OUTSIDE_BASE_PREFIXES` (SIG-REL-008) — the
  prefill href joins via `rootPath`, so a snapshot page links the live
  receiver, never its own pinned copy.
- No `<script>`, `on*=` handler or `javascript:` URL added — T1
  zero-JS preserved; `nojs-parity`/`script-policy` sweeps green over
  every discovered route.
